claim: Use the C simulator with frame-level hooks for analysis and censuses; per-instruction Python hooks are far slower.

evidence.text: rzx_census counts and finds the first frame of given PCs over a 90K-frame recording in about 4 minutes with the C simulator against about an hour in Python; a whole-recording sheet capture takes about 70 s.
Graphics catalogue over the whole recording with the C simulator, graphics hashed at each frame end, takes 7.6 s.
